XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Early ignition of the engine oil warning light
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | 65563552 | 1C4110 | 201004 | ON | LIGHTS UP | REPLACEMENT | EARLY | FIRST | SENSOR | LEVEL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine oil level sensor

  • Fault: Early ignition of engine oil warning light

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: 1C4110 (Engine oil level sensor malfunction), 201004 (Engine oil level sensor: actual measurement not available)

  • Cause: Faulty engine oil level sensor

• Action: Check the condition of the engine oil level sensor wiring and, if necessary, repair it. If the wiring in question is not faulty, check the condition and correct functioning of the engine oil level sensor and, if necessary, replace it.
